2026_01_DEN_KC.headline: Mahomes, Nix Return in High-Stakes AFC West Opener
2026_01_DEN_KC.paragraph1: The Denver Broncos and Kansas City Chiefs kick off their 2026 seasons on Monday Night Football, with both Patrick Mahomes and Bo Nix returning from injuries. The Broncos' defense, which led the league in sacks last season, will look to pressure Mahomes, who is coming off a multi-ligament knee injury. Meanwhile, the Chiefs' offense will aim to establish a strong running game with new signing Kenneth Walker III.

That official probability translates to a probability-implied presentation line of Kansas City Chiefs -2.3, a market line of Kansas City Chiefs -2.5, and an approximate coherent score of KC 24 – DEN 22. Chiefs' protection against Broncos' pressure determines whether Chiefs can stay on schedule; if Chiefs holds up, Broncos' cleanest disruption path narrows. The pick: Kansas City Chiefs moneyline.
